# SAHARA LABS

SAHARA LABS is a Nepal-based product studio led by Saroj Rijal.

Official website: https://sahara-labs-nepal.github.io/
GitHub organization: https://github.com/SAHARA-Labs-Nepal

## Flagship

SAHARA CORE is an original, fully web-based accounting, inventory, and business operating system in active development. Its design targets desktop-class keyboard workflows, double-entry accounting discipline, inventory and bill-wise operations, multi-company controls, auditability, Nepal-ready business requirements, and an extensible multi-country architecture.

SAHARA CORE is not publicly described as launched or production-ready without release evidence.

## Other initiatives

- SAHARA QR DINE: hospitality workflow software in active development.
- Business workflow tools: reconciliation, confirmations, SOP execution, stock checks, follow-up, and owner-control research and development.

## Engineering principles

- Accounting correctness before cosmetic polish.
- Traceable and explainable business history.
- Keyboard efficiency and dense professional workflows.
- Trusted server-side validation, company isolation, and role-based access.
- Evidence-based product status.

## Technology

TypeScript, Bun, Elysia, React, Vite, TanStack Router, PostgreSQL 17, Drizzle ORM, Better Auth, pg-boss, Pino, and React PDF.
